# Truck Agents

> Truck Agents repairs, services and maintains heavy duty trucks, trailers and light commercial vehicles across Gauteng and its outskirts, South Africa.

Website: https://www.truckagents.co.za
Phone and WhatsApp: 067 601 4490
Email: info@truckagents.co.za
Service area: Gauteng and its outskirts

## Services
- [Heavy Duty Truck Repairs](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/heavy-duty-truck-repairs): Breakdowns, faults and full repairs on trucks and truck tractors of every make.
- [Truck Engine Overhauls](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/truck-engine-overhauls): Full diesel engine strip downs, rebuilds and overhauls for trucks.
- [Gearbox and Transmission Repairs](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/gearbox-and-transmission-repairs): Manual and automated truck gearbox repairs, rebuilds and replacements.
- [Truck Servicing and Maintenance](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/truck-servicing-and-maintenance): Scheduled services and preventative maintenance to keep your fleet moving.
- [Truck Spray Painting and Cab Repairs](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/truck-spray-painting-and-cab-repairs): Panel beating, cab repairs and full truck respraying in your fleet colours.
- [Diesel Tank Fitting and Fuel System Repairs](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/diesel-tank-fitting-and-fuel-system-repairs): Fuel tank fitting, repairs, injectors and fuel pumps for trucks.
- [Trailer Axle and Bearing Maintenance](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/trailer-axle-and-bearing-maintenance): Axle, hub and wheel bearing repairs for trailers and truck rear ends.
- [Tipper and Trailer Body Repairs](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/tipper-and-trailer-body-repairs): Repairs and fabrication for tipper bodies, flatbeds and trailers.
- [Truck Wheel, Tyre and Brake Repairs](https://www.truckagents.co.za/services/truck-wheel-tyre-and-brake-repairs): Wheel, hub, tyre and brake work to keep loaded trucks safe.
